methods: Tauc plot from UV-vis diffuse reflectance spectra (DRS)
band gap.description: Energy needed to excite an electron from the valence to the conduction band. Usually from UV-vis DRS with a Tauc plot, written like 'the band gap of ... is 2.72 eV'. Do not confuse with sub-bandgap / midgap transitions or DFT-calculated values unless asked.

BET surface area.description: Specific surface area from N2 physisorption using the Brunauer-Emmett-Teller (BET) method. Often in a table or the text near the isotherm figure.

methods: N2 adsorption-desorption isotherm (BJH or single point)
pore volume.description: Total pore volume from N2 physisorption, usually reported together with the BET surface area.

methods: BJH pore size distribution from N2 isotherm
pore size.description: Average or peak pore diameter, usually from the BJH pore-size distribution.

methods: Photocatalytic H2 evolution measured by gas chromatography
H2 evolution rate.description: Rate of photocatalytic hydrogen production, normalised by catalyst mass (per g per h). Papers use µmol or mmol: report the unit exactly as written. Note the light source and sacrificial agent in 'method'.

methods: Photocatalytic O2 evolution measured by gas chromatography
O2 evolution rate.description: Rate of photocatalytic oxygen production, normalised by catalyst mass.

methods: Measured under monochromatic light at a given wavelength
apparent quantum yield.description: Percentage of incident photons that drive the reaction. Always note the wavelength (e.g. 'at 420 nm') in 'method' or 'note'.

methods: Scherrer equation from XRD peak broadening
crystallite size.description: Average crystallite size, usually calculated from XRD peak width with the Scherrer equation.

methods: Mott-Schottky plot, or calculated from band gap and VB position
conduction band potential.description: Conduction band edge potential. Note the reference electrode (vs. NHE, RHE, Ag/AgCl) and pH in 'note'. Negative values are common.

methods: VB-XPS, or calculated from band gap and CB position
valence band potential.description: Valence band edge potential. Note the reference electrode (vs. NHE, RHE, Ag/AgCl) in 'note'.

photocurrent density.description: Current density under illumination. Papers use µA or mA cm-2: report the unit exactly as written.

C:N ratio.description: Atomic ratio of carbon to nitrogen in the carbon nitride (dimensionless). Ideal g-C3N4 is 0.75; nitrogen vacancies raise it, carbon vacancies lower it. Report it as a ratio (e.g. 0.72), not as weight %. Note the method (elemental analysis or XPS) because they give different values.

defect type.description: Atomic- or electronic-scale imperfection deliberately introduced in the photocatalyst. Report the type (e.g. 'nitrogen vacancy', 'oxygen vacancy', 'S doping'); give the element in 'note' for doping. Use 'none' for the pristine reference sample.

heating rate.description: Temperature increase per minute during the thermal treatment (calcination / pyrolysis), e.g. '5 °C min-1'. In PDF text the degree sign may appear as '◦C' or '℃'.

heating temperature.description: Maximum temperature of the thermal treatment used to make the sample. If there are several heating steps, report the one that forms or modifies the main sample and describe the others in 'note'. Convert K to °C (subtract 273).

heating time.description: Time the sample is held at the heating temperature (not the ramp time). Report in hours: convert minutes (e.g. 30 min = 0.5 h) and keep the original wording in the evidence.

atmosphere.description: Gas environment during the thermal treatment. If the paper does not state it (e.g. a muffle furnace with no gas mentioned), use 'air' as Li et al. did, and say 'not stated, default air' in 'note'.
